std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined fs (frame sync) 1
bit header field.
The value range for version shall be:
0x00...0x01 : valid
0x02...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the middleware shall set value to 0, if it is not provided by the application.
